summary: Costamare Bulkers Holdings filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 8, 2026, reporting the election of one Class I director, Dimitrios Sofianopoulos, at its virtual 2026 annual meeting of stockholders, to serve until the 2029 annual meeting. Stockholders also ratified Ernst & Young (Hellas) as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium or advisor is disclosed. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer meeting-result filing, not a special situation; no risk-arb angle applies.
